source.title: MoE Parallel Folding: Heterogeneous Parallelism Mappings for Efficient Large-Scale MoE Model Training with Megatron Core

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: The article’s attention grid uses tensor four, context two, data eight and pipeline four: two hundred fifty-six ranks. Its expert grid uses expert tensor one, expert sixty-four, expert data one and pipeline four: the same two hundred fifty-six. Expert data means copies of a given expert shard. It need not equal attention’s data degree.
teaching.moment: Show the same ranks receiving different attention and expert ownership grids.
teaching.scope: Retain separate TP/CP/DP and ETP/EP/EDP labels; matching rank products alone does not establish compatibility.
teaching.caption: The same ranks can use distinct attention and expert ownership maps.

figures.locator: Figure 1, right-hand attention/expert pair; other mappings omitted (PDF p. 5)
